title: Weight of a translated varifold is the translated weight
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let U, U' ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be arbitrary sets, let V be a rectifiable n-varifold in U with carrier M and multiplicity θ, let W be a rectifiable n-varifold in U', and let x₀ ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Suppose the carrier of W is {y : y + x₀ ∈ M} and W's multiplicity satisfies W.mult(y) = θ(y + x₀) for all y. Then the weight μ_W = Hⁿ⌞W.carrier⌞W.mult equals the pushforward of μ_V = Hⁿ⌞M⌞θ under y ↦ y − x₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U U' : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U') (x₀ : Amb n ℓ), W.carrier = (fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' V.carrier → (∀ y, W.mult y = V.mult (y + x₀)) → W.weight = V.weight.map (fun y => y - x₀)
